text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
G-good morning! About yesterday, um...
I'm so sorry for my
ineptitude! Today, I'll
d-do better!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
About that, actually. I have a suggestion,
if I may?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Um, Rob Roy, you had a lot on your
shoulders yesterday, didn't you? You
made the plans, lead the way, explained
everything, told us what
to do...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
So, if it'll help, should I give the
instructions? If you tell me what
needs to
be done, I can take it from there.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, gosh... Well, thank you. I think it
would be safer to do it that way
too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Just relax and leave it to me.
I'm actually,
well... If there's one thing
I'm good at, it's
worrying about things.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Okay! I've noted down the switch's
location and taken a picture! Let's
go back
and show everyone!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You and me'll find the second switch,
while Dober's group retries the
Lonely
River!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It's a carefully thought-out plan. Hehe.
That's so Dober!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes. To be honest,
I'm also quite relieved.
Oh, sorry. The way back
is... this way?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(What a predicament. I could find out for
sure if I checked the book,
but... I can't
just take it out here...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Uhhh, it's this way!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Okay! Right behind you!

text_block_list.name: Rob Roy & Taiki
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh!
Nooo!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
O-ouch! Who knew there were random
cliffs in the forest?! I don't see
any way of
climbing back up from here.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'll message everyone on LANE. "Help me!"

Oh, Rob Roy, you don't look very well!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry! So sorry! If...
if I'd just told the
truth, I could've checked the
route in the
book!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
A-and yesterday too,
if I'd told the truth,
we could've checked the
book first and
avoided that whole fiasco!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Rob Roy, calm down! What's all this
about? Take your time,
okay? Tell me
what happened, nice and slow.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: The truth is... that story isn't from a movie, it's from a children's book. Rhodonite and the Dreamstone, it's called.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: A book?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
If only I'd told the truth sooner, we
could've avoided a lot of trouble.
I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I knew it all sounded familiar! You mean
it's from that book? The
Lonely River,
Ghillie Dhu's Garden, the Dreamstone...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...What?! Y-you mean you've read the
book too?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! When I was little,
my friends used to
love it! We would all read
it together!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, b-but wait a minute! Does that mean we've been exploring that world this whole time?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
And I got lots of pictures of it all!
Haha!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Now that I know, this looks exactly like
the Lonely River that I'd
imagined! The
undine's spring too, and the forest, the
animals...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The Tree Man, the red mushroom, they
were all in the story! If I
remember
correctly, near the red mushroom was a cat
wearing shoes!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Th-that's right! There was a meeting with
the cat-sìths! That's where
they asked the
villagers to drive away the kelpies!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Yeah, I remember! And then, the
cat-sìths invite them into
their kingdom,
and they say—

text_block_list.name: Rob Roy & Taiki
text_block_list.text: "Tokubetsu ni shoutai shiyou. Juppondo de ii." "Just for you, ten pounds and you're in!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Haha! So that's how the line goes in
Japanese!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe it! I never imagined we'd
have so much fun talking
about books
together!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...But of course. Books truly are amazing.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(What made me think they were childish?
They transcend borders and
time, bringing
people together!)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there they are! Heeey! You okay, you
two?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Man, you sure did give me a shock. Your
"Help me!" was so sudden. Oh, the other
two are still looking for you.
I'll let them
know.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Thank you! You found us so quickly!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
That's because I thought I saw a fairy
dressed in black over here.
When I
followed it, I found you guys!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I might just be imagining things, but
there's so many mysteries to this
place, it's
really fun!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Someone normal like me never could've
found a place like this! Man, I
hope I get
to watch the movie someday!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah! Um, about that...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: What? So it wasn't a movie, it was a book?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...I-it's a little embarrassing,
but... well, I
thought a movie would
sound more
mature, so...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hm. So basically, you want to be more
mature?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh? Uh, not exactly... It's just...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
N-none of my classmates are into
children's literature like I am.
There's one
who knows a lot about cosmetics, and
everyone's
interested in that kind of stuff...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
So I kind of started to feel embarrassed
about liking books...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It's not that they're mature, they're just
into makeup. And it's not that you're
childish,
you're just into books. Don't you
think?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And you know what, they're both unique
and amazing in their own
way. I mean...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
As someone who's never really gotten
deep into reading, makeup, or
any kind of
hobby, they're both equally amazing to
me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I definitely never would've seen the
campsite map and thought, "This
is just
like that story! A-ha!" on my own, you
know?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So, um... yeah! You're fine as you are!
Right, Taiki?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yep! You're A-OK!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I'm fine... as I am?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh... I'd...
never thought of it that way...
